API ReferenceBusiness Insights APIReport ConfigurationsCreate Report Configuration (Custom Apps)
Create Report Configuration (Custom Apps)
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/reports/:report_type

Create a Report Configuration associated with Custom Applications. Please note that currently, only the customapps report_type is supported.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
report_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [customapps]

Type of report. Currently only "customapps" is supported.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
report_schema
string[]

Optional list of fields to include in the report output. The available fields depend on the selected sub_type: For OVERVIEW: application_name, access_path, uniqueuserscount, transactions For USERS: application_name, access_path, user_email_id, transactions, login_date

delivery_information
object[]
schedule_params
object
backfill_params
object
name
string
REQUIRED
sub_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [OVERVIEW, USERS]

enabled
boolean
Default value: true
custom_ids
int32[]
REQUIRED

Currently supports exactly one Custom App reference ID. Multiple values will be rejected.

Possible values: >= 1, <= 1

Examples
One-time backfill report (OVERVIEW sub_type)
One-time backfill report (USERS sub_type)
Scheduled report (OVERVIEW sub_type)
Scheduled report (USERS sub_type)
Responses
​
201
400
401
403
405
415
429
500

Report configuration created successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
backfillOverview
backfillUsers
scheduledOverview
scheduledUsers
